app.seit-alles-was-du: {b} ({email}, since {uhrzeit}). Everything you do now happens under this account.
app.die-zwei-faktor-anmeldung: Two-factor sign-in is required for your role.
app.richte-sie-jetzt-ein: {b} Set it up now or add a passkey – otherwise, at the next sign-in at the latest, you can only continue afterwards.
app.passkey.vorgeschrieben: A passkey is required for your role.
app.passkey.richte-ihn-ein: {b} Add one now – otherwise, from your next sign-in, you can only continue after adding it.
messpanel.noch-keine-anfrage-auf: No request on this page yet.
messpanel.warten-browser-der-browser: “Waiting (browser)”: the browser sends at most about 6 requests at once; the rest wait. “Waiting (server)”: arrival until processing. “Line” is an approximation (round trip minus time in the server) and also includes the wait before the server accepts the request – if it is busy, this shows under Workbench → Database as “Load”. Switch off in your profile.
messpanel.die-anfrage-wartete-im: The request waited in the browser until a connection was free.
messpanel.hin-und-rueckweg-ohne: Round trip without the time in the server (approximation).
messpanel.vom-eingang-der-anfrage: From the request arriving at the server until processing.
messpanel.berechtigungen-auswerten-ohne-: Evaluating permissions (without the database accesses in it).
messpanel.antwort-im-server-in: Converting the response to text in the server.
messpanel.antwort-an-den-browser: Sending the response to the browser.
messpanel.antwort-im-browser-lesen: Reading the response in the browser.
messpanel.bis-der-browser-das: Until the browser has drawn the result.
person.nicht-sichtbar.titel: You aren’t allowed to see this user – their folder isn’t readable for you.
speicherleiste.was-du-eingegeben-hast: What you entered won’t be created.
speicherleiste.die-felder-gehen-auf: The fields go back to the saved state.
ueberdms.ablago-ist-die-dokumentenablage: Ablago is the document library for home and small businesses. It runs on your own computer, NAS or server – your data stays with you and goes to no cloud provider. It sends no usage data.
ueberdms.freie-software-du-darfst: {link} – free software: you may use, change and pass on Ablago free of charge; the source code is open for everyone to see.
ueberdms.nutzt-du-ablago-erzaehl: Do you use Ablago? Tell us about it
erreichbar.ablago-ist-gerade-nicht: Ablago can’t be reached right now.
erreichbar.vermutlich-laeuft-ein-update: {b} Probably an update or restart is running. I’ll keep trying{wert}. Your entries stay; save again afterwards.
erreichbar.lade-die-seite-neu: {b} Reload the page so that the interface and server match. Save unsaved entries first.
erreichbar.zeigt-die-seite-noch: {b} If the page still shows errors, reload it.
veraltet.nicht-geladen: The interface couldn’t be loaded completely – Ablago has probably just been updated. Reload the page.
veraltet.neu-geladen: {b} The page has therefore been reloaded. Your entries are still there; only passwords need to be entered again.
fehlergrenze.text: The page could not be displayed. Reload it – your saved data is not affected. If it happens again, please report the error.
fehlergrenze.kopiert: The technical details are on the clipboard. Send them to the person who looks after Ablago.
fehlergrenze.nicht-kopiert: Copying did not work. The message is under “Technical details”.
ort.es-gibt-ungespeicherte-aenderungen: There are unsaved changes. If you leave the page, they will be lost.
wartung.abmeldung-andere: Maintenance – everyone else will be signed out in {dauerText}.
wartung.abmeldung-du: Maintenance – you will be signed out in {dauerText}.
wartung.nur-personen-die-verwalten: {b} Only people who may administer are signed in; the interface for programs and background work are paused.{zusatz}
wartung.anmelden-aktiv: {b} Only people who may administer Ablago can sign in.
wartung.anmelden-bald: {b} Until then, only people who may administer Ablago can sign in.
wiederherstellen.die-sicherung-ist-einge: The backup {b} has been restored ({zeit}). Sign in with your previous credentials – the ones from the time of the backup.
wiederherstellen.der-bisherige-stand-ist: The previous state is unchanged. Details are in the log (module sicherung).
wiederherstellen.sicherung-bitte-lass-di: Backup {b}. Please keep this window open; Ablago restarts once at the end.
wiederherstellen.ablago-startet-neu-glei: Ablago is restarting … it will continue shortly.
wiederherstellen.der-jetzige-stand-von: The current state of Ablago will be replaced by the backup. It is backed up itself first.
wiederherstellen.gesucht-im-sicherungsor: Looked in the backup folder {span}. Put both files there ({span2} and {span3}).
wiederherstellen.keine-sicherung-im-ordn: No backup found in the folder.
wiederherstellen.mir-ist-klar-der: I understand: the current state will be replaced by the backup. Ablago backs it up itself first; changes since the backup will then only exist in that backup.
ziehen.ziehen-zum-verschieben-touch: Drag to move (touch: long press) – by keyboard with Alt+arrow keys
muster.einleitung: Pattern page for development and tests: every building block in every state. It only exists in development mode and in the test build.
muster.feld.text: Frame for every input: label, input, hint and error – with the help icon next to the label and the links for screen readers.
muster.beschriftung.name: Name
muster.hinweis.kundennummer: Shown at the top right of every invoice.
muster.hinweis.email: Ablago sends reminders and questions to this address. It is never shown publicly.
muster.hinweis.mappennummer: Ablago assigns it when you save.
muster.hinweis.erinnerung: On the day before the appointment.
muster.hinweis.wochentage: The reminder comes on these days.
muster.hinweis.ausprobieren: Try it: move the mouse over it or jump into it with the Tab key.
muster.hinweis.geschuetzt: changed by an administrator in user management
muster.fehler.email: Please enter a complete address, e.g. lena@example.org.
muster.fehler.gelesen: Please confirm that you have read the terms.
knopf.fehler: That didn't work. Please try again.
muster.knopf.text: Fixed kinds (Create, Main, Secondary, Danger, Link for ways only) and the same states everywhere: disabled with a reason, “working”, result and error right at the button.
muster.knopf.ergebnis.fehler: The server isn't answering. Please check the address and port.
muster.knopf.ausprobieren: Click: the button shows “working”, then the result or the error below it.
muster.einheit.text: Period and percentage: number and unit on one line, singular and plural to match the number, the number pad on phones.
muster.fehler.zeitraum: Please enter a whole number, for example 3.
muster.fehler.prozent: Please enter a number, for example 7.5.
muster.tabelle.text: Rows with columns, each leading to a page. Wide a table, narrow a list with the first two columns; without rows a quiet sentence.
muster.suche.text: One search field for every list, in the Library as in the Workbench: magnifier, placeholder, clear with “×” or Esc. In Workbench lists the filters and the number of results sit below it; every result shows where it was found.
muster.suche.platzhalter: Search in name, fields, help texts …
muster.suche.kuendigen.hilfe: The date by which you have to cancel so that the contract doesn’t renew.
muster.suche.faellig.hilfe: When the invoice has to be paid.
muster.umschalter.text: Two to four equal choices side by side, exactly one is on – such as “Ask · Search” above the box on the start page. Tab reaches the chosen one, the arrow keys choose the next.
